title: SDK conformance case
description: One input and its expected outcome. Every SolvaPay SDK runs every case and must produce the same outcome.

suite.description: The folder the case lives in, under cases/.

description.description: What the case pins down, and why, for a person reading a failure.

fn.description: The operation, by its language-neutral name (camelCase). Each runner maps it to its own library's function.

args.description: The operation's arguments, as one JSON object with camelCase keys.

clock.description: The time the operation runs at, for anything that reads the clock.

expect.description: Either the result, compared as JSON (a missing key and an undefined value are the same; null is not), or the error.

code.description: The error's stable code. Messages are not compared.
